description: This file defines a PHP class for the Microsoft ADO database driver using COM objects, including connection management, schema retrieval, query execution, and recordset handling.

classes.name: ADODB_ado
classes.description: Main class for handling ADO database connections and schema operations for PHP using COM with support for connecting, querying, and schema metadata.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ado
classes.description: Class representing a recordset for ADO database queries, including navigation, field fetching, and data retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for ADODB_ado class, initializes affected rows object.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves server provider description and version information.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection using connection string parameters and COM objects.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Permanently establishes a persistent connection to the database.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about tables in the connected database.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns of a specified table.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query, with optional input parameters, returning a recordset object or false on error.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message from the database connection.
